Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.provisioning.assets

Record Class PluginArtifactSpec

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.provisioning.assets.PluginArtifactSpec
Record Components:
sourceType - Source type.
path - Local path for PATH sources.
groupId - Maven group id for MAVEN sources.
artifactId - Maven artifact id for MAVEN sources.
version - Maven version for MAVEN sources.
classifier - Optional Maven classifier.
type - Maven artifact type.
includeTransitive - Whether transitive dependencies should be copied.
renameTo - Optional output filename override.
uri - Direct artifact URI for URL sources.
sha256 - Required SHA-256 checksum for URL sources.
modrinthProject - Modrinth project slug or ID for MODRINTH sources.
modrinthVersion - Modrinth version number for MODRINTH sources.
modrinthVersionId - Modrinth version ID for MODRINTH sources.
modrinthLoader - Modrinth loader to select. Defaults to Bukkit during config resolution.
modrinthGameVersion - Optional Minecraft version filter for Modrinth version selection.
public record PluginArtifactSpec(PluginArtifactSpec.SourceType sourceType, @Nullable Path path, @Nullable String groupId, @Nullable String artifactId, @Nullable String version, @Nullable String classifier, String type, boolean includeTransitive, @Nullable String renameTo, @Nullable URI uri, @Nullable String sha256, @Nullable String modrinthProject, @Nullable String modrinthVersion, @Nullable String modrinthVersionId, @Nullable String modrinthLoader, @Nullable String modrinthGameVersion) extends Record
Validated plugin artifact provisioning input.
